title: Slow Roads v1.0.2 Se/B7 -> Ca -> xi pinned archive execution
description: Read-only oracle from Slow Roads/resources/app.asar. Normal: 96000 ticks, observer=-17+floor(tick/16). Fast: 24000 ticks, observer=-17+floor(tick/4). Warmup uses original load conditions. Unity standalone tile retirement (lastSeen<observer-100) is explicitly applied to both references. spatialProbe is a separate synthetic negative-coordinate Ca input.
$comment: events.hash is FNV-1a-style uint32 accumulation over Float32 words in position,normal,uv,bridge,shadow,paintSolid,paintSolidLeft,paintSolidRight,paintMergeLeft,paintMergeRight order. Indices are covered by P4 tests. Exact discrete IDs/order/hash; phase tolerance 1e-10; squared distance tolerance 1e-8. Fast raw source can build incomplete segments: Unity's whole-segment backpressure intentionally diverges from that mesh schedule; only path output is compared there. reverts counts original non-extension updates, not necessarily Restarted. Terrain/vehicle/rendering are not executed.
